mutants.name: unknown-repo-is-non-infra
mutants.why: UNKNOWN must fail shut — treating it as non-infra lets an unplaceable path auto-clear (E1); must break test 4's fail-shut assertions

mutants.why: the governance-existence redirect (E5) is what makes a bare DRAFTING_CYCLE.md filed from tuyere resolve to governance and hold; dropping it lets it auto-clear

mutants.name: drop-governance-knowledge-exemption
mutants.why: governance/knowledge/ must be exempt from the infra test just as knowledge/ is; dropping it makes governance knowledge writes shop-infra (breaks test 5's absolute governance knowledge path assertion)

mutants.name: ignore-config-extension
mutants.why: config['shop_infra_projects'] must extend the floor; ignoring it means custom infra repos (my_forge) never hold, breaking test 9's extension assertion

mutants.name: floor-from-config-only
mutants.why: the hardcoded floor must not be disableable; making the floor empty means config={} or config={'shop_infra_projects': []} leaves no infra names, breaking test 9's floor assertions

mutants.name: drop-warnings-pass-through
mutants.why: thread 199: _rerun_validation must pass a warnings list to cycle_check.run_check so the DRIFT cause appears in the hold sidecar; dropping the kwarg means warnings are never collected

mutants.name: drop-name-floor
mutants.why: the name floor (fork 5) makes GOVERNANCE.md shop-infra in any repo; dropping it lets a plan touching GOVERNANCE.md auto-clear from a non-infra project

mutants.name: name-floor-on-raw-write-not-rel
mutants.why: the name floor must test rel (the resolver-derived relative path), not the raw write spelling (E4); testing the raw write means <parent>/tuyere/GOVERNANCE.md from bellows would not trigger the floor
mutants.anchor: rel_path = Path(rel) if rel else Path(".")
mutants.replacement: rel_path = Path(normalized) if normalized else Path(".")

mutants.name: declare-is-project-file
mutants.why: the literal <declare> must be UNKNOWN in every context (E8); treating it as the project's own file lets a plan with <declare> writes auto-clear instead of holding

mutants.name: governance-identity-by-name-not-resolver
mutants.why: governance must be identified by the resolver (resolve_governance_root()), never by directory name (E6); removing the resolver-based detection means a governance root named 'GitHub' is not recognised as governance
mutants.replacement: pass  # governance identity by resolver removed

mutants.name: every-project-under-G-is-governance
mutants.why: on the shop shape, only G itself and G/governance are governance, not every checkout under G (C1); using is_relative_to(G) makes invoice-pulse and tuyere checkouts look like governance, misclassifying relative writes from them
